scope: Both variable branches of ordinary exact Feature owning-type featuring. Not full Feature/Usage transformation.

normative.boundary: The snapshot definition carries an explicit library redefinition and a TypeFeaturing to its owning type; full derived featuringType, redefinition validation and specialized Usage behavior remain separate obligations.

native_consumer: materialize_owning_type_featuring delegates variable inputs to definition_materialize_variable_featuring. Occurrence owners reuse library snapshots; others construct and contain a snapshot Feature with redefinition and context relationships. Algorithms are explicitly handwritten Rust over imported definitions.

checks: outer implied relationship and feature source
snapshot TypeFeaturing source and owner target

remaining: Generalize provider dispatch by pinned resolved getter/adapter identity rather than per-subtype patches

disagreements: None observed in these five controls. Snapshot naming and per-invocation fresh identity are Pilot implementation choices, not asserted normative requirements.
repeat_policy: Non-Occurrence variable calls create a fresh snapshot, matching direct upstream compute invocation. Callers provide fresh construction identities; duplicate identities reject atomically. Reused library targets suppress duplicate TypeFeaturing insertion.
